reviews.author: Samantha Conway
reviews.text: I am so impressed with the amount of pride Seamus puts into his work. My car was not only given back to me spotless and sparkling, but he was even able to remove scratches along the body of the car! I would recommend him to everyone! My car looks better than it did the day I drove it off the lot.

reviews.author: Chris Chia
reviews.text: My car was recently semi flooded by a flash flood on a city street. Seamus came and took care of the horrible smell that was coming from my car in the days after the event! He went all out making sure the problem was gone and offered to follow up in the days afterwords but no need! Would reccomend to anyone!

reviews.author: Lena Lowe
reviews.text: Excellent job . Had my daughters car detailed and it literally looks like it came off the showroom floor . All done at the privacy of our own home . Cannot wait to get my own van done . Highly recommend . Thank you so much for the special attention and detail you did on our daughters car . We will recommend you to everyone !!!!!! See you soon for my van .

reviews.author: Elyissia Chinchilla
reviews.text: Amazing service. My SUV was way overdue for a cleaning. 5 hours later it was like a brand new one. On time, courteous, professional and impeccable attention to detail. Highly recommend!!!!!
